nodes.title: Plasticity after the task changes
nodes.question: Does search-time replanning restore the learning ability a value network loses after the task changes, or only postpone its decay?
nodes.motivation: Persistent learners must keep adapting after repeated distribution shifts.
nodes.scope: Matched update histories, compute, and unseen post-shift learning curves.

nodes.title: Search restores future learning
nodes.statement: Search-time replanning preserves features that make later value updates effective.
nodes.rationale: Planning can reduce pressure to encode transient policy shortcuts in the value network.
predictions: The advantage survives matched endpoint performance

nodes.title: Choose the causal matching target
nodes.question: Should the first controlled study match endpoint performance or the full training path?
consequences: Determines whether retention and future plasticity can be separated

nodes.title: Two-update matched trajectory
nodes.objective: Measure future learning after matching the first update's compute and endpoint behavior.
nodes.design: Train value-only and search-assisted arms through one shift, then measure learning on an unseen second shift.
expected_outcomes: Search changes the second-shift learning curve
Endpoint-only gains disappear under path matching
interpretation_rules: Current performance is not future plasticity
A single checkpoint is not a learning curve
nodes.current_summary: The repaired smoke is running; the first two attempts exposed unrelated data and checkpoint failures.
nodes.next_action: Inspect the first complete second-shift learning curve.

nodes.title: Endpoint matching leaves different learning paths
nodes.observation: Two arms reached similar endpoint return while their update-wise KL and gradient norms diverged.
nodes.interpretation: Endpoint equality alone does not isolate the mechanism responsible for later learning.

nodes.title: Resume omitted optimizer state
nodes.description: The second smoke could not preserve the intended update history after resume.
nodes.resolution_condition: Checkpoint and reload optimizer plus scheduler state.
nodes.recommended_action: Keep the repaired resume assertion in the smoke test.
